interpretation.rejected_candidate: Playwright context.route with an exact static-origin glob caused an unrelated cross-origin request to bypass a real denied OPTIONS preflight: the native endpoint saw GET only and the browser resolved 200. This candidate must not support native CORS/security acceptance claims.
interpretation.accepted_method_control: Direct CDP Fetch Response interception used an exact static-origin prefix. The browser captured static entity bytes while the unrelated native endpoint received OPTIONS and returned 403; the browser rejected the cross-origin fetch, matching the unrouted baseline.
